anatomy.description: Required non-empty localized option text contributing the accessible name.

attributes: checked content attribute establishes defaultChecked in static HTML
checked IDL property represents live selection
behavior.description: The canonical native Checkbox owns pointer, keyboard, live checkedness, form reset, and disabled behavior; K11 adds no neutral controller.

behavior.name: formValue
behavior.description: When a target supplies a name and value, the checked native input is the sole successful form entry; the target still decides what that entry means.

behavior.name: dependencyComposition
behavior.description: K11 is the canonical Checkbox root and optionally contains one canonical Price; it does not duplicate their state, indicator, formatting, accessibility, or runtime.

behavior.name: targetMutation
behavior.description: The commerce target maps checkedness to one order-level sellable gift-wrap line at quantity one, then reconciles confirmed checkedness and totals from its authoritative cart snapshot while owning eligibility, idempotency, pending, error, retry, status, focus, stale-response, and analytics behavior.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: Source order remains control, required label, then optional price; localized and unbroken text wrap inside the owning container without viewport-dependent markup.

accessibility: Use one native checkbox inside the wrapping label so its complete visible label and optional Price remain one activation target and accessible name.
Preserve canonical Checkbox checked, disabled, Space, focus-visible, forced-colors, reduced-motion, form submission, and reset behavior.
Keep a non-empty visible option label even when Price is present; price alone is not an accessible name and absence does not mean free.
Use describedBy for target-owned unavailability or explanatory content instead of inserting interactive descendants inside the wrapping label.
Announce confirmed cart-total or mutation results from the target cart lifecycle only when the asynchronous outcome meets the status-message criterion; K11 is not a live region.
Keep target request failure from silently reverting or confirming selection without an error, retry, and checkedness reconciliation policy.
Map confirmed selection to exactly one explicit sellable gift-wrap service line at quantity one, including a truthful canonical zero Price when configured.

web.notes: Native Checkbox and optional canonical Price composition require zero K11 runtime. Form meaning, mutation, totals, result feedback, and reconciliation remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: A target-native snippet, global dedicated single-variant product setting, and Ajax coordinator implement the accepted sellable-line candidate. Live merchant configuration, eligibility, Cart Page/Drawer refresh, inventory/tax/fulfillment policy, errors, focus, and editor proof remain required before target readiness.

react.notes: Controlled or uncontrolled Checkbox composition may project target mutation state without introducing React into base source.
